newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins 1 bln franc GSM order.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins 1 bln franc GSM order.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Thursday it signed a one billion franc agreement with French Societe Francaise du Radiotelephone (SFR) for the supply of GSM infrastructure until the end of 1998.
Under the agreement, Nokia will deliver to SFR base stations, base station controllers, operation systems and network implementation and related services.
"The first order placed under this agreement is valued at 400 million French francs," Nokia said, but gave no details.
Nokia said it had started to deliver GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) infrastructure to SFR in October 1993.
